def simplify_ratio(a, b):
  gcd = lambda x, y: x if not y else gcd(y, x % y)
  common_divisor = gcd(a, b)
  return a // common_divisor, b // common_divisor
print(simplify_ratio(6, 8))  # Output: (3, 4)
